t: Create ClaudeCode advisor skeleton — absorb maximizer rubric into persistent advisor with scan_state and passes tracking
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer.md — the 8-area rubric, trigger conditions, gap report format, fix mode to absorb. 2. Read templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer-reference.md — detailed guidance per area. 3. Read WAI-Spoke/advisors/historian/ structure — scan_state.json, passes.jsonl, vectors.jsonl, reviews/ as template. 4. Read WAI-Spoke/skills/WAI-Skills.jsonl line 32 — current maximizer registration.
execute: 1. Create WAI-Spoke/advisors/cc-advisor/ with: scan_state.json ({last_audit_at: null, current_score: 0, score_by_area: {all 8 areas: null}, sessions_since_last_audit: 0, total_audits: 0, pending_proposals: [], auto_applied_count: 0}), empty passes.jsonl, empty vectors.jsonl, reports/ dir. 2. Create WAI-Spoke/skills/cc-advisor/cc-advisor.md — absorb the 8-area rubric from wai-claude-maximizer.md, add: periodic audit lifecycle (every 10 sessions), score history tracking, regression detection trigger, advisor state read/write instructions. Keep lean (behavioral only). 3. Create WAI-Spoke/skills/cc-advisor/cc-advisor-reference.md — absorb from wai-claude-maximizer-reference.md, add: event schemas, proposal format, hub signal format. 4. Create .claude/agents/cc-advisor.md — agent that reads scan_state, runs 8-area scoring, writes results to passes.jsonl, detects regressions via score delta, writes vectors for regressions. 5. Update WAI-Skills.jsonl: replace claude-maximizer entry with cc-advisor (id: cc-advisor, command_file: cc-advisor.md, type: guard, advisory: true). 6. Edit templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer.md to 3 lines: 'Absorbed into ClaudeCode advisor. Run /cc-advisor or read WAI-Spoke/skills/cc-advisor/cc-advisor.md.' 7. Sync skill files to templates/spoke/skills/cc-advisor/ and WAI-Spoke/commands/.
verify: 1. python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("WAI-Spoke/advisors/cc-advisor/scan_state.json"))' — valid JSON with all 8 area keys. 2. wc -l WAI-Spoke/skills/cc-advisor/cc-advisor.md — under 200 lines (lean). 3. grep 'cc-advisor' WAI-Spoke/skills/WAI-Skills.jsonl — registered. 4. grep -c 'claude-maximizer' WAI-Spoke/skills/WAI-Skills.jsonl — 0 (replaced). 5. cat templates/commands/wai-claude-maximizer.md — shows redirect message.
acceptance_criteria: WAI-Spoke/advisors/cc-advisor/ directory exists with scan_state.json, passes.jsonl, vectors.jsonl
scan_state.json has all 8 area keys with null initial values
cc-advisor.md skill file exists under 200 lines (behavioral only)
cc-advisor-reference.md contains absorbed maximizer reference content
WAI-Skills.jsonl has cc-advisor entry replacing claude-maximizer

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Phase 1 of CC advisor epic — create the advisor skeleton, absorb the maximizer, register the new skill
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not implementing observation hooks or analysis yet — just the structure and absorbed rubric. Phases 2-5 are separate tasks.
